answer_1.outputs: adversarial sentences concatenated to original paragraphs for QA and sentiment classification

answer_2.quote: ... Targeted attack success rate (abbr. target) is measured by how many examples are successfully attacked to output the targeted label ... Untargeted attack success rate (abbr. untarget) calculates the percentage of examples attacked to output a label different from the ground truth ... For QA we use exact match (EM) and F1 scores ...

answer_4.quote: ... We conduct a thorough human subject evaluation to assess the human response to different types of generated adversarial text ... human participants are asked to choose the data they think has better quality ... we ask human participants to perform the sentiment classification and question answering tasks both on the original dataset and adversarial dataset ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to compare adversarial and original texts for quality and to answer sentiment classification and QA questions on both versions.
